in_sanskrit.name: Biresh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of auspiciousness
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Biresh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Biresh is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vish’ which means 'auspicious'. This name is believed to bring good fortune, prosperity, and positive energy. It is also associated with the Hindu deity Vishnu, who is known as the preserver of the universe.
